title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Playoff
items.text: Joaquin Niemann won LIV Golf Korea in Busan after beating Talor Gooch in a playoff for his eighth LIV title, the most by any player since 2022, stabilizing LIV as it seeks new funding after Saudi PIF's 2026 exit.

items.headline: Potgieter’s NCAA Bogey Record
items.text: Louisiana's Malan Potgieter extended his bogey-free streak to 91 holes at the NCAA Championship, breaking Alabama's Bobby Wyatt's 74-hole record and approaching Tiger Woods’ professional mark of 110 straight bogey-free holes.
